service.name: Plan & Monitor — tokenized stock trade tasks
service.feeNote: Free during listing review; priced later via x402 on the network stated in GET /v1/products.
service.description: Turns a goal (assets, budget, limits, deadline) into a finite set of checked candidates, then keeps the intent alive: it re-verifies continuously and issues a 60-second step certificate only while conditions hold. The user signs one TradeMandate; every step is executed by the user's own wallet or agent through the PlanGuard contract on X Layer. The service never holds funds and never sends transactions.
whatYouGet: Up to 12 deterministic candidates per goal: amount ladder x funding asset x three policies, each with completion ratio, adverse price impact, blocking reason codes and an explicit next step.
A recommended candidate only when it is eligible under the chosen policy; shrinking the amount is never counted as completing the original goal.
Continuous monitoring with a plain-language delta on every evaluation: what changed, what it affects, what happens next.
Step certificates (EIP-712) bound to the mandate, the evidence hash and the exact router calldata; expired certificates are void, never reused.
A signed evidence bundle that a third party can verify offline (hashes, signatures, rule re-run) and online (receipt vs. event).
service.whatNoResultMeans: A plan with no feasible candidate, a window that stays in WAIT, or a rejected policy check is a delivered service: it tells you which limit or condition blocks the goal. Nothing is executed and no execution fee is charged.
limits: One issuer (xStocks), EOA wallets only (no EIP-1271).
Reference price source is Finnhub; a close taken from the 16:00 ET last trade is labelled close_last_tick until the next day confirms it.
The service holds exactly one key: the attestation signer. It cannot move user funds.
Admin can pause, rotate the signer epoch and edit allowlists - a stated trust boundary, not trustlessness.
service.disclaimer: Verification of data comparability and execution constraints only. Not investment advice; no guarantee of fill or profit.

service.name: Agent Tasks — event impacts and task drafts for tokenized US stocks
service.feeNote: Free during listing review; a paid tier would need its own SKU (CV-D) and x402 on the network stated in GET /v1/products.
service.whatItIs: Given an owner wallet and/or a set of xStocks tokens, returns which scheduled market events (earnings, tier-1 macro, Fed, holidays, early closes) touch those assets, and a set of ready-to-create task drafts: playbook + machine-checkable conditions (session, event window, earnings window, step gap) in SIMULATION mode, or a dated REPLAY when no event is in range. The same conditions later gate certificate issuance for a signed TradeMandate; execution is always authorized separately by the owner's wallet.
whatYouGet: Event impacts per asset: relation (company_direct / user_rule / macro_research), effect on existing tasks, and the six allowed actions; macro events are labelled research-only and never phrased as a price prediction.
Task drafts with an explicit conditions hash (conditions/1) that can be POSTed to /v1/tasks unchanged; each draft names its mode (SIMULATION or REPLAY with the replay date).
Field-level honesty: when the event calendar or impacts are not available, the field says status=unavailable and the drafts fall back to a dated replay instead of pretending to be live.
GET /v1/context free tier (tier=agent): session, event list, Fed blackout, curve shape and drift verdict — derived fields only, every field with source, observedAt and status.
service.whatNoResultMeans: An empty impact list or a replay-only draft set is a delivered result: it means nothing scheduled touches these assets in the horizon (or the calendar is unavailable and says so). Nothing is executed and nothing is charged.
inputs: assets? (symbols or eip155 keys; at least one of owner/assets)
service.transport: HTTP 200 only during review: missing input → 200 status=input_required with schema and example; success → 200 status=delivered. Invalid JSON also returns 200 input_required.
limits: Drafts are not investment advice; conditions describe when the agent may act, not what the price will do.
Impacts need an owner with holdings/tasks on this service; asset-only calls return event coverage without holdings.
The service holds exactly one key: the attestation signer. It cannot move user funds.
service.disclaimer: Event and condition information only. Not investment advice; no guarantee of fill or profit.
